text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05, up 0.84% on the day and 6.07% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.9% (5‑day gain 5.59%). Advances outpaced declines (355 vs 134) giving a breadth score of 73, which the system labels “HEALTHY”. About 80% of stocks sit above their 20‑day moving average, showing the rally is fairly broad‑based.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers of INR 12,563.33 crore, extending a 10‑day buying streak, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 8,434.53 crore, marking an eight‑day net‑sell run. In the options market, Nifty’s put‑call‑ratio (PCR) is 0.77, indicating more call than put interest, with a “max‑pain” level around 25,100 and a call wall near 26,000. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.17 (more puts), max‑pain at 58,000 and a call wall at 60,500, suggesting some resistance ahead.

Watch the 25,258 pivot (P) and the first support at 25,092 on Nifty; a break below could test the 24,500 put wall. For Bank Nifty, the pivot at 60,854 and support at 60,314 are key, while a move above the 60,500 call wall may fuel further upside. Keep an eye on oil price easing (Brent $94.1) and the rupee near 93.68, as both can influence sector flows, especially auto and banking.
